_comment: Scan-space landmarks for Meshy horse 01a14bbf-8905-71a9-a340-f28cf12319ba (Blender axes after glTF import: nose -Y, +X is the horse's left/.L side, +Z up). rig_meshy_quadruped.py grounds the hooves, scales withers_z to withers_height and applies the same transform to every point here. Joint positions were read from ortho side renders and per-quadrant leg centroid slices; the far hind leg (RB) stands about 0.2 forward of the near one, as in the scan.
_withers_height: 1.30 m (HORSE-2 / 1343 dossier) in world units: 2 units per 1.82 m

weights._comment: Scan-space heights/offsets. belly_z: underline between the legs; limb_top_pad: how far above each Leg bone head limb weight fades out.

hair._comment: Scan-space mane span (crest y at poll and withers), forelock root height on the poll and a lower face-line height (the face profile itself is ray-cast), dock root and stump tip.
